p: DFRN is a Korean deep-tech startup, applying AI-driven de novo design to discover and develop novel REE-binding proteins. Our primary targets are neodymium(Nd) and dysprosium(Dy), essential materials for NdFeB permanent magnets. Building on naturally occuring REE-binding protein, we aim to design proteins with improved REE selectivity, yield, and protein manufacturability through a closed-loop dry-wet lab system. By the end of 2027, we aim to advance protein reusability, reduce the number of separation stages, and develop an efficient, fully aqueous separation process. Through these innovations, DFRN seeks to pioneer a more sustainable and efficient processes for rare earth extraction.

Hit rate for De novo Enzyme (Esterase case : 15%, 18 activation of 120 candidates )

Just nine months after launching its PETase program, DFRN successfully developed a functional enzyme candidate. Building on this AI-driven de novo protein design capability, DFRN is now rapidly and effectively expanding into the extraction and recovery of critical materials, especially rare earth elements.
